subject: Future Tech
title: Privacy Inside Your Skull
description: Learn Privacy Inside Your Skull in one minute.

hook.text: If a device can read your brain, who else might listen in? Neural privacy is a brand-new legal frontier.

buildup.text: BCIs collect intimate data: your intentions, emotions, and cognitive patterns.

discovery.text: Chile became the first country to add neurorights to its constitution in 2021, protecting mental privacy by law.

twist.text: Tech companies already struggle to protect phone data. Brain data would be the most sensitive information ever stored.

climax.text: Researchers warn that without regulation, neural data could be used for surveillance, profiling, or manipulation.

punchline.text: Your thoughts may need a firewall someday.

quiz.question: Which country first added neurorights to its constitution?
